recommendedTextbook.title: Home Economics for Junior Secondary Schools Book 1
recommendedTextbook.author: Elizabeth U. Anyakoha
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: Meaning and Scope of Home Economics
subtopics: Definition and objectives of Home Economics
Three major areas: Food and Nutrition, Clothing and Textiles, Home Management
Career opportunities: Dietitians, fashion designers, caterers, interior decorators
objectives: List the three main integrated areas of study
Identify 4 career paths available to Home Economics students in Nigeria

topics.topic: The Human Body: Care of Hands, Feet, Teeth and Skin
subtopics: Structure of the skin and hair
Daily care of teeth, preventing dental caries and plaque
Care of hands, feet, and trimming nails cleanly
objectives: Diagram the structure of the human skin showing sweat glands
Explain the causes of tooth decay and demonstrate correct tooth brushing techniques
Outline daily personal grooming habits for adolescents

subtopics: Physical and emotional changes during puberty in boys and girls
Personal hygiene rules, clean clothing, and managing body odor
objectives: Identify secondary sexual characteristics in adolescent boys and girls
Explain safe menstrual hygiene practices and disposal of sanitary materials
Differentiate healthy peer relationships from risky adolescent behavior

topics.topic: Sewing Tools and Basic Sewing Stitches
subtopics: Classification of sewing tools: Measuring, marking, cutting, sewing equipment
Care and safety when using scissors, pins, and needles
Temporary stitches (even basting) vs permanent stitches (running stitch, backstitch)
objectives: Demonstrate threading a needle and sewing a flat running stitch sample
Distinguish temporary basting stitches from permanent backstitches
